Lemma
Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0081 1. Lemma 3.2\group variation-formulas

If $\partial _t g_{ij}=h_{ij}$, then the Levi-Civita connection varies by \[ \partial _t\Gamma ^k_{ij} = rac12 g^{k\ell } igl( abla _i h_{j\ell }+ abla _j h_{i\ell }- abla _\ell h_{ij} igr). \]

Proof

Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0081 \sketch In geodesic coordinates at a point, $\Gamma ^k_{ij}=0$ and $\partial _i= abla _i$ at that point. Differentiating the coordinate formula for $\Gamma ^k_{ij}$ and then invoking tensoriality gives the result globally.

□
